title: DDIAS is a single-stranded DNA-binding effector of the TOPBP1-CIP2A complex in mitosis
authors: Kaima Tsukada; Liudmyla Lototska; Aya Tsukada; Ipek Ilgin Gönenç; Charlotte Sherlaw-Sturrock; Manil Kanade; Antony W. Oliver; Samuel E. Jones; Satpal S. Jhujh; Julius Bannister; Asmat Ali; Muhammad Raza; Mathias Toft; Zafar Iqbal; Ambrin Fatima; Thomas C. R. Miller; Grant S. Stewart; Fena Ochs; Andrew N. Blackford
one_liner_zh: 该文鉴定DDIAS作为TOPBP1-CIP2A复合物的单链DNA结合效应子，研究有丝分裂中ssDNA保护机制，但核心为湿实验功能鉴定，无AI或物理模拟方法，且非典型TF-DNA体系，仅边缘相关。
abstract: DNA double-strand breaks and unresolved DNA replication intermediates are particularly dangerous during mitosis. Paradoxically, cells inactivate canonical DNA repair mechanisms during chromosome segregation in favor of alternative pathways that depend on TOPBP1 and CIP2A, but how they function is still poorly defined. Here, we describe the identification of DDIAS as a mitosis-specific DNA damage response protein. We establish DDIAS as a phosphorylation-dependent component and effector of the TOPBP1-CIP2A complex with single-stranded DNA (ssDNA)-binding activity, and thereby delineate a ssDNA protection mechanism that safeguards chromosome integrity during mitosis, particularly in BRCA-deficient cells. We also identify biallelic inactivating mutations in DDIAS in a patient with a severe neurodevelopmental disorder. These findings highlight for the first time a potential physiological role for the DNA damage response in mitosis.
abstract_zh: DNA双链断裂和未解决的DNA复制中间体在有丝分裂期间尤为危险。矛盾的是，细胞在染色体分离过程中会失活经典的DNA修复机制，转而依赖依赖于TOPBP1和CIP2A的替代途径，但这些途径如何运作仍知之甚少。在此，我们描述了将DDIAS鉴定为一种有丝分裂特异性DNA损伤反应蛋白的过程。我们确定DDIAS是TOPBP1-CIP2A复合物的磷酸化依赖性组分和效应器，具有单链DNA（ssDNA）结合活性，从而描绘了一种ssDNA保护机制，该机制在有丝分裂期间保障染色体完整性，尤其在BRCA缺陷细胞中。我们还在一名患有严重神经发育障碍的患者中鉴定了DDIAS的双等位基因失活突变。这些发现首次突显了DNA损伤反应在有丝分裂中的潜在生理作用。
